 Rishabh Shandilya Mon, November 16, 2026 at 5:58 AM UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Photo Credit: Dia Dipasupil/FilmMagic via Getty Images Nicholas Hoult has offered a glimpse into the early days of his relationship with Bryana Holly. The actor usually keeps his family life away from the spotlight, but a podcast appearance gave him a chance to revisit their first date. He also shared how an unexpected music plan brought them together.
 Nicholas Hoult discusses his early romance with Bryana Holly on Therapuss Podcast
 Their first outing was anything but a low-key dinner. Nicholas Hoult revealed on the Therapuss podcast that he was filming a movie when he and Holly started talking about music. Their conversation led to plans for Desert Trip, the 2016 festival featuring the likes of The Rolling Stones, Bob Dylan, Paul McCartney, Neil Young, Roger Waters and The Who.
 Hoult described the idea as a "really fun" first date, although he admitted it may have been an "overcommitment." Since they barely knew each other, the pair first met for dinner to make sure neither was a "complete lunatic" before committing to the festival trip.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Hoult and Holly have kept their love life well away from the spotlight. Rumors of a romance first surfaced in 2017, months after the pair attended Desert Trip together. The actor has never revealed their wedding date, though he dropped a hint in December 2024 when he casually called Holly his wife during an interview (via EW ).
 Hoult now has a busy household with four young kids. He and Holly welcomed their first son, Joaquin, in 2018, then added another child to the family in 2022. Earlier this month, his How to Rob a Bank costar Pete Davidson revealed that the couple had twins. Davidson also gave Hoult a shout-out as a "great dad," pointing out that he is now raising four children, all younger than 7. "Four under what? 7 [years old] … which is nuts," Davidson said.
 Davidson also praised the actor's commitment to family while they worked together. His own partner, Elsie Hewitt, was expecting during filming, while Hoult had recently welcomed the twins. Davidson recalled that Hoult would "fly back every weekend" to spend time with his family.
